content: We have retrieved polymorphs for 40 compositions (max_compositions 40). Now need to consolidate all individual polymorph files into a single comprehensive dataset, each entry should have source_composition. Use consolidate_polymorph_datasets tool. It expects composition_files as a dictionary mapping composition to file path. We have that mapping in result. Need to pass that. Also specify output_path maybe. Let's construct composition_files dict from result. Use tool.
